verdict.rationale: The evidence shows employees can submit time-off requests via the MCP server and that the CLI can 'act on time off requests'. Nothing documents defining PTO policies, configuring accrual rules, or having approved leave flow automatically into payroll. Handling individual requests is related to the story but is not the policy-and-accrual capability it asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define PTO policies with accruals and approvals that apply automatically to payroll
